promise: The I Promise School will open in Akron in fall 2018 — 'the most important thing I'll ever do' (as reported).
description: I Promise School opened in Akron in July 2018.
evidence: NBA reporting confirms the opening; it does not support additional school openings in 2023 or 2025.

review.note: The NBA confirms the school opened July 30, 2018. This does not establish a prior promise made that same day, the quoted superlative, or the August 31 deadline. Remove the unsupported claims of second and third schools; the original promise chronology remains unresolved.
